summary: Revise contract: Extend Taskboard ticket creation in the same feature. When the source thread/composer clipboard contains an image, allow it to be attached to the new ticket, and support Ctrl/Cmd+V image paste directly in Create new ticket. Use BB-native or existing tracker upload/attachment flows, show previews/removal/upload errors, and never silently lose an image. Improve the AI draft prompt so it produces a concise, specific title and description from rough input and relevant image context without inventing facts. Replace the single create flow with explicit Start now and Create only actions: both create the issue exactly once; Start now then begins Taskboard automatic work, while Create only opens the newly created issue inside Taskboard and does not start an agent. Preserve metadata, draft, idempotence, accessibility, compact layouts, and current provider behavior.

state.request: Fix the Taskboard automatic-start behavior that pauses work when a build reports recoverable blockers like the supplied Roten-App result. Improve automatic work startup so blocker summaries are handled accurately and the task does not stop prematurely when actionable implementation work can continue, while preserving genuine human-decision, tracker, evidence, and policy gates.

sizeDecision.reason: This is the third refinement of one already-implemented and installed Taskboard delivery branch. The progress UI now depends on the same Factory run contract and navigation introduced by the earlier build-resumption iteration, while ticket drafting is already implemented. Splitting now would duplicate history and destabilize the installed local feature; keep one revision and verify capabilities independently.
